      <bpmn:documentation>It must be valid in Austria, remain valid at least three months beyond the visa duration, have at least two empty pages, and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo measuring 35 x 45 mm that meets the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareInsurance" name="Prepare travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive cover for the planned duration of stay, with cover of EUR 30,000, valid throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectOtherEvidence" name="Collect other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Depending on the location and circumstances, evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment, or other evidence requested by the authorities.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" name="Required documents prepared"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Grounds for refusal present?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForResponse" name="Wait for representation response"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" name="Receive request for additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional requested documents"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" name="Submit additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive visa decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa issued?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge" name="Merge visa outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WorkstreamsJoin" name="Accommodation, bank account, and visa work complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalOutcome" name="Visa outcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaIssued" name="Accommodation and bank account organized; visa issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaRefused" name="Accommodation and bank account organized; visa refused"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Accommodation and bank account organized; application cannot proceed due to refusal ground"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSplit" sourceRef="Start_Planning" targetRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToAccommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccommodationToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToBank" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToVisa" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VisaEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaEntryToContact" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaEntry" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactToRequirements" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsToCategory" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryToAC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineACCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">category = 'A' or category = 'C'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryToD" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineDCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">category = 'D'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ACToDistrict" sourceRef="Task_DetermineACCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictExceptional" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">legallyResident and not registeredInDistrict</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictNotExceptional" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not (legallyResident and not registeredInDistrict)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JustificationToDistrictMerge" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictToCategoryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DToCategoryMerge" sourceRef="Task_DetermineDCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryMergeToAuthority" sourceRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectIssuingAuthority"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AuthorityToDocuments" sourceRef="Task_SelectIssuingAuthority" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToForm" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FormToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToTravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocumentToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToPhoto" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhotoToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToMeans" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeansToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToOtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidenceToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsJoinToGroundsCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GroundsCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GroundsPresent" name="Grounds present" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">residenceProhibition or schengenAlert</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrounds" name="No grounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not residenceProhibition and not schengenAlert</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToResponse" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseToDocumentRequest" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentRequestToPrepare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToSubmitAdditional" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAdditionalToResponse" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseToDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionIssued" name="Issued" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaIssued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionRefused" name="Refused" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not visaIssued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaOutcomeToWorkstreamsJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WorkstreamsJoinToFinalOutcome" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkstreamsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalIssued" name="Visa issued" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome" targetRef="End_VisaIssued">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaIssued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalRefused" name="Visa refused" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome" targetRef="End_VisaRefused">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaRefused</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalGrounds" name="Application cannot proceed due to refusal ground" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome" targetRef="End_RefusalGround">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refusalGroundPresent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
